name: faculty_report
query:
SELECT

    f.faculty_id AS "Faculty ID:Data:120",
    f.name1 AS "Faculty Name:Data:180",
    f.email AS "Email:Data:200",

    ta.problem_id AS "Problem ID:Data:120",
    ta.resisdents AS "Resident:Data:180",
    ta.technicians AS "Technician:Data:180",
    ta.priority AS "Priority:Data:100",
    ta.status AS "Status:Data:120"

FROM `tabFaculty` f

LEFT JOIN `tabTASK-ASSIGN` ta
ON ta.parent=f.name

ORDER BY
f.name1;
